title: F2 Counter Carry
statement: Let $x$ and $b$ be finite Boolean lists, and let $p$ be an input-head position among the $|x|+2$ positions associated with input $x$. For every finite Boolean list $u$, starting the counter machine in state $1$ with input-head position $p$, work-tape head at $|u|$, tape contents specified by the counter tape for $u$ concatenated with $b$, and empty output, after $c(b)+1$ steps it is in state $2$, with input-head position $p$, work-tape head at $|u|+c(b)-1$, tape contents specified by the counter tape for $u$ concatenated with the increment of $b$, and empty output, where $c(b)$ is the number of leading true entries of $b$.
hypotheses_covered: Input-head position $p$ among the $|x|+2$ valid positions
